title: Personal Loans Courtesy Waivers: AutoPay Courtesy Point
content:
## Rule

An AutoPay courtesy point applies to a Personal Loans courtesy waiver, looking at the loan's latest AutoPay enrollment and latest AutoPay cancellation (each on a tie of dates the first one recorded; an enrollment and a cancellation on the same date make the enrollment the later record): when the enrollment is on or after the cancellation, that cancellation was automatic (reason bank account closed or consecutive returns) and the enrollment is fewer than 8 days before the request date (a count of days between two dates being the later date minus the earlier), 0.3; when the enrollment is the later record in any other case, or there is no cancellation, 0.15; when AutoPay is off, no point.

A point is added to the courtesy share by which the courtesy amount is taken; the courtesy share is held between zero and one.

| Latest AutoPay records on the loan | Point |
|---|---|
| enrollment on or after an automatic cancellation, enrollment fewer than 8 days before the request | 0.30 |
| enrollment on or after an automatic cancellation, 8 or more days before | 0.15 |
| enrollment on or after a cancellation the borrower asked for, or the loan closing | 0.15 |
| enrollment and no cancellation | 0.15 |
| cancellation after the latest enrollment, or no enrollment | none |

## Cases (hypothetical, request on 20 April)

- Cancelled automatically, reason consecutive returns, on 2 April; re-enrolled 13 April: 7 days: 0.30.
- The same with re-enrollment on 12 April: 8 days: 0.15.
- Cancellation and enrollment both on 15 April after the account changed: the enrollment is the later record.
